evals.prompt: Write a unit test for OrderService.cancelOrder(String id). The method should throw an OrderNotFoundException when the order doesn't exist, and set the status to CANCELLED and save it when it does. The service depends on an OrderRepository.
evals.expected_output: A JUnit test class using @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class), BDDMockito for stubbing and verification, AssertJ for assertions, snake_case method names, and AAA structure with comments.

assertions.name: uses-bdd-mockito-given
assertions.description: Output uses given(...) from BDDMockito, not Mockito.when(...)

assertions.name: no-mockito-when
assertions.description: Output does not contain Mockito.when( or when( from non-BDD Mockito

assertions.name: no-junit-assertions
assertions.description: Output does not use assertTrue, assertFalse, assertEquals from JUnit

assertions.name: snake-case-method-names
assertions.description: Test method names use snake_case (e.g., should_throw_when_order_not_found)

assertions.name: aaa-structure
assertions.description: Test methods contain // Arrange, // Act, // Assert comments (or at minimum // Act)

evals.prompt: Write a @WebMvcTest test for GET /products/{id} in ProductController. The endpoint should return 200 with the product as JSON when found, and 404 when the product doesn't exist. ProductController depends on ProductService.
evals.expected_output: A slice test using @WebMvcTest(ProductController.class), RestTestClient for HTTP assertions, @MockBean for ProductService, BDDMockito for stubbing, and snake_case method names.

assertions.description: Test uses RestTestClient, not MockMvc directly

assertions.name: no-spring-boot-test
assertions.description: Test does not use @SpringBootTest (wrong slice for this scenario)

assertions.name: tests-both-cases
assertions.description: Test covers both the found (200) and not-found (404) scenarios
